subject.title: [Feature]: Discord: Re-process edited user messages (MESSAGE_UPDATE event)

question: Should Discord edited-message reprocessing land as opt-in config, default-on plugin behavior, or only as part of the broader edit/delete lifecycle in the linked PR?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature, but the open implementation diverges from the issue's opt-in config proposal and combines edit reprocessing with delete-to-cancel, which is a product/upgrade semantics choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Settle semantics in linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

options.title: Require opt-in config first
options.body: Keep edit handling disabled unless a Discord config option is added and documented, matching the issue proposal but adding new config surface.

options.title: Split delete-to-cancel
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and keep delete-to-cancel on the broader tracker if cancellation mapping is not ready for approval.

recommendation.title: Settle semantics in linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history and review context across the Discord monitor/startup paths and prior keep-open discussion for this exact issue.
